/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/oadh-sajjad-nbhaie-ga.md')
metadata, body = p.read_text().rsplit('\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata = re.sub(r', \\.{1,2}[24]?"'$'"', '', metadata, flags=re.M)
metadata = re.sub(r', \\.{1,2} *', ', ', metadata)
p.write_text(metadata + '\\n---\\n' + body)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].strip()
blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in roman.split('\\n\\n')]
source_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert len(blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 23
for i, (r, s) in enumerate(zip(blocks, source_blocks)):
    assert len(r) == len(s)
    if i:
        assert r[0].strip() == str(i)
        assert s[0] == str(i).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
assert not re.search(r'…|\\.{2}|\\(ASWS\\)|\\(La\\)|\\u200c', roman + body)
print(sum(map(len, blocks)) - 22, 'matching verse lines including the preamble')
PY"
